Remark
[Differentiating contraction-count estimates] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0244 1. ch13:13.25\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

If $S\preccurlyeq C A*B$, then $ abla S\preccurlyeq C abla A*B+C A* abla B$. Thus, unlike a norm inequality, a contraction-count relation may be differentiated.
